one_month_reasoning: No company-scheduled hard catalyst inside Oct 2-31: Q3 results are expected ~Nov 9 (outside the window). In-window: Oct 28 FOMC (Kalshi 71% hold / 28% hike, Polymarket 74.5% hold, both 2 Oct) - a hike would hit capital-intensive AI-infrastructure names that have been trading on 10y yields (5.3%, 24-year high); possible CB-4 energization/Justified $3.5B debt launch headlines (mild +); continued insider-sale overhang and sector momentum are negative (stock -13% in the last week of Sept). These roughly offset, so I use a near-symmetric lognormal centered slightly below spot (median ~$14.75) with ~25% monthly vol (91%/3.5 = 26%).

fair_value.method: Blend of an unlevered DCF of contracted leases plus a probability-weighted pipeline ($11.6, 50%), a stabilized-NOI cap-rate SOTP ($13.0, 35%) and a 50%-haircut sell-side consensus cross-check ($17.2, 15%) = ~$12.8 per share 12 months out.

base.story: Lake Mariner CB-4/CB-5 delivered, HPC revenue run-rate ~ $0.75B by mid-2027, Justified financing closes and first halls energize on schedule, perhaps one modest new lease. Rates stay high; stock trades near fair value with volatility.

bull.story: A large new hyperscaler/AI-lab lease (Muskie or Morgantown, 300-500 MW) is signed, rates ease, and the AI-infrastructure trade re-rates toward the June 2026 high (~$30) and consensus targets.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$8 the market would be valuing WULF at or below contracted-only value at a 9%+ cap rate (my DCF with no new contracts gives $8.4), which would most likely mean a fundamental problem: a tenant credit event (Fluidstack/Anthropic), a material Justified delay or cost overrun, a failed/dilutive financing, or an AI-capex bust - not ordinary 90%-vol noise.

Whether the AI-capex cycle holds through 2027 (Polymarket ~18% on an AI industry downturn by end-2026)
Execution/timing and cost of Justified Data (401 MW, ~$4.4B capex) and its $3.5B financing
Pace of new contracting vs the 250-500 MW/yr target
Dilution from penny warrants, RSUs and in-the-money converts; insider selling overhang

reasoning: Facts: Q2'26 revenue $44.8M (HPC $31.9M), 102 MW online, 336 MW under construction at Lake Mariner (Fluidstack ~$6.7B/10yr), new 401 MW/20-yr $19B Anthropic lease at Justified Data (online H2'27-early'28), $3.0B cash vs $5.2B debt, ~613M FD shares. Base rates: the stock and its peer group (IREN, APLD, CIFR, CORZ) have repeatedly fallen 30%+ in a month on rate and AI-sentiment shocks (Jul and Sep 2026) despite rising sell-side targets; WULF peaked at $29.84 in June, fell ~50% and has ranged $14-$19 since July. Realized vol 91%; for such names the 12-month median outcome sits well below the mean because of volatility drag, so I center the lognormal at ~$13.5 (between my $12.8 fair value and spot) with sigma ~0.72 and a slightly fatter right tail for lease-announcement jumps. Macro: 10y 5.3% and a hike-leaning Fed (Kalshi/Polymarket ~25-28% Oct hike) are headwinds; Polymarket prices ~18% for an AI downturn by end-2026 and Bitcoin markets matter little now (HPC ~70% of revenue). DCF (explicit inputs above) gives $11.6 at 10.5% WACC, very rate-sensitive ($8-16 across 9.5-11.5%); cap-rate SOTP ~$13; sell-side cross-check haircut ~$17; blend $12.8. Scenario mean ~$16, median ~$13.5-14. P(>= spot) ~45%. Twelve Data fundamentals/estimates endpoints were plan-gated, so consensus came from stockanalysis.com.
